project_statement: Event-level parameter-estimation/provenance dependence is retained as a closed upstream evidence layer; XBICA does not numerically propagate its branch metrics downstream.
Population inference is retained as a closed methodological layer; its relationship to later cosmology is structural under mismatched release/frame contracts, not a measured transfer coefficient.

Selection/injection dependence remains a scientifically meaningful bridge that cannot be evaluated under the frozen public-asset boundary. The NO-GO is preserved as evidence, not interpreted as absence of selection effects.
Primary remnant/ringdown cross-branch interpretation remains blocked by unresolved public schema semantics. The HOLD is preserved and is not interpreted as a null physical result.
Candidate/catalog surface evidence provides an upstream identity/provenance layer, but XBICA establishes only bounded structural links to PE, selection, ringdown and cosmology.
Public strain/DQ/calibration is retained as the lowest upstream layer. Its connection to downstream detection, PE and cosmology is structural; no end-to-end numerical transfer was measured.
External-release transport is retained as an identity/reproducibility boundary. No replication or nonreplication result is claimed because no compatible replication test was executed.

Public standard-siren H0 outputs exhibit bounded descriptive dependence on frozen analysis choices, while primary status remains 10/12 and no true-H0, bias-causation or Hubble-tension-resolution claim is licensed.
